en.headline: Japanese tourist robbed of HK$15,000 in Tsim Sha Tsui hotel room
en.dek: A 19-year-old woman was attacked after opening her door at The Imperial Hotel on Monday night; the suspect fled and no arrests have been made.
body: Police received a report of a suspected robbery at The Imperial Hotel on Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui at around 9pm on Monday.

Officers and paramedics found a 19-year-old Japanese woman with injuries to her neck. According to initial investigations, she heard the doorbell, opened the door and was attacked by a man aged between 30 and 40 who grabbed her by the neck and seized about HK$15,000 in cash before fleeing.
The woman was treated at the scene. No arrests have been made and police are continuing inquiries.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒店日籍女遊客遭搶 損失1.5萬元
zh.dek: 19歲日本女子周一晚在帝豪酒店房門被襲，頸部受傷，約1.5萬元現金被搶，疑犯逃走，暫無人被捕。
body: 警方周一晚約9時接報，尖沙咀彌敦道帝豪酒店發生懷疑劫案。
到場人員發現一名19歲日本籍女子頸部受傷。初步調查顯示，事主聽到門鈴後開門，一名約30至40歲男子突然扼住其頸部，搶去約1.5萬元現金後逃去。
事主在現場接受治理。案件暫無人被捕，警方繼續調查。
